# Interface renames must include authentication call sites, not only the interface and implementation

Bug 1882574 renamed msgIOAuth2Module.initFromSmtp to initFromOutgoing and changed OAuth2Module to read the generic server URI and legacy prefs. SmtpAuthenticator still called initFromSmtp. A follow-up two days later changed that call to initFromOutgoing, fixing the missed OAuth2 SMTP authentication path. Trace consumers of a renamed XPCOM method, including runtime paths that compile or lint without exposing the error. The accepted follow-up is D210038.

Scope: Outgoing OAuth2.

Paths:

- `mailnews/base/src/MailAuthenticator.sys.mjs`
